ZuljinBoneslicer.name: Boneslicer
ZuljinBoneslicer.description: Grievous Throw now pierces through all enemies hit and restores 15 Mana per Hero hit. Additionally, Grievous Throw's mark is no longer removed by Basic Attacks.

ZuljinRecklessness.name: Recklessness
ZuljinRecklessness.description: While Zul'jin is below 75% Health, he gains 10% Spell Power. While he is below 50% Health, his Basic Attack damage is increased by 15% and Basic Attacks against Heroes grant an additional stack of You Want Axe?.

ZuljinHeadhunter.name: Headhunter
ZuljinHeadhunter.description: Quest: Zul'jin's first Takedown against each enemy Hero permanently increases his damage dealt by 2%. Reward: After getting Takedowns on every enemy Hero, Basic Attack range is increased by 1.1.

ZuljinTrollsBlood.name: Troll's Blood
ZuljinTrollsBlood.description: Increase Regeneration's healing by 25%. If Regeneration fully finishes, restore 10% of Zul'jin's maximum Mana.

ZuljinVoodooShuffle.name: Voodoo Shuffle
ZuljinVoodooShuffle.description: Activate to remove Roots and Slows. Passive: Lower the cooldown and Mana cost of Regeneration by 40%.

Zul'jinAmaniRageAmaniHide.name: Amani Hide
Zul'jinAmaniRageAmaniHide.description: Lower the cooldown of Amani Rage by 10 seconds and gain 15 Armor while regenerating Health from it.

ZuljinViciousAssault.name: Vicious Assault
ZuljinViciousAssault.description: Increase the duration of Grievous Throw's mark by 3 seconds and its damage bonus by 45%.

ZuljinArcaniteAxes.name: Arcanite Axes
ZuljinArcaniteAxes.description: Quest: Twin Cleave's damage is permanently increased by 0.75 every time it hits a Hero.

ZuljinFerocity.name: Ferocity
ZuljinFerocity.description: Increases the Attack Speed bonus of Berserker by 40%.

ZuljinTazdingo.name: Taz'dingo!
ZuljinTazdingo.description: For the next 4 seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than 1 Health. Taz'dingo!

ZuljinGuillotine.name: Guillotine
ZuljinGuillotine.description: Zul'jin launches a massive axe into the air that drops on the targeted area, dealing 330 (+4% per level) damage plus bonus damage the lower his Health is.

ZuljinLacerate.name: Lacerate
ZuljinLacerate.description: Increase the Slow amount of each Twin Cleave axe by 10% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

ZuljinEyeOfZuljin.name: Eye of Zul'jin
ZuljinEyeOfZuljin.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant Zul'jin 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%.

ZuljinEnsnare.name: Ensnare
ZuljinEnsnare.description: Throw a net forward, Rooting the first enemy Hero hit for 1.5 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, Ensnare's cooldown is reduced to 10 seconds.

ZuljinNoMercyTalent.name: No Mercy!
ZuljinNoMercyTalent.description: Zul'jin's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes marked with Grievous Throw ignore Armor and deal an additional 2% of maximum Health as damage.

ZuljinWrongPlaceWrongTime.name: Wrong Place Wrong Time
ZuljinWrongPlaceWrongTime.description: If an enemy is hit by both Twin Cleave axes at the same time, they take an additional 100 (+4% per level) damage and count as 5 Hero hits for You Want Axe?.

ZuljinLetTheKillingBegin.name: Let the Killing Begin
ZuljinLetTheKillingBegin.description: When Zul'jin kills an enemy, his Attack Speed is increased by 5%, up to 40%, for 12 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration. Hero Takedowns instantly grant 40% Attack Speed.

ZuljinAmaniResilience.name: Amani Resilience
ZuljinAmaniResilience.description: Increase Taz'dingo's duration by 1 second. Upon expiring, Zul'jin heals for 50% of the damage he dealt during Taz'dingo.

ZuljinBuzzsaw.name: Buzzsaw
ZuljinBuzzsaw.description: After impact, Guillotine continues forward, dealing 75% damage to enemies hit. If a Hero is killed by Guillotine, Zul'jin is instantly healed to full.

ZuljinForestMedicine.name: Forest Medicine
ZuljinForestMedicine.description: Regeneration is no longer Channeled, and cannot be interrupted.

ZuljinPassiveASurpriseForYa.name: A Surprise For Ya
ZuljinPassiveASurpriseForYa.description: Basic Attacks bounce to a nearby enemy for 50% damage, prioritizing enemy Heroes.
